name: Marketing
overview: Scripture teaches that marketing, including network marketing, should be conducted with diligence, integrity, and reliance on God's guidance. Proverbs emphasizes honest labor over vanity in gaining wealth, while Luke highlights the importance of treating others as we wish to be treated and being wise in our dealings. Committing our work to the Lord ensures our efforts are established, and God promises to grant wisdom and courage to overcome challenges in our endeavors.
